title: SRE-01 Workshop — Traces
description: EDOT / Managed OTLP traces on traces-workshop.otel.otel-default. Same layout as Platform logs.

data_source.query: FROM traces-workshop.otel.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | STATS count = COUNT(*)
FROM traces-workshop.otel.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE attributes.`event.outcome` == "failure" | STATS count = COUNT(*)
FROM traces-workshop.otel.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE attributes.`http.response.status_code` >= 500 | STATS count = COUNT(*)

FROM traces-workshop.otel.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | STATS count = COUNT(*) BY `@timestamp` = BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend), resource.attributes.`service.name`
FROM traces-workshop.otel.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | STATS count = COUNT(*) BY attributes.`event.outcome`
FROM traces-workshop.otel.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | STATS count = COUNT(*) BY resource.attributes.`service.name` | SORT count DESC | LIMIT 10

FROM traces-workshop.otel.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE attributes.`http.response.status_code` IS NOT NULL | STATS count = COUNT(*) BY attributes.`http.response.status_code` | SORT count DESC

FROM traces-workshop.otel.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE attributes.`event.outcome` == "failure" | STATS count = COUNT(*) BY resource.attributes.`service.name`, name | SORT count DESC | LIMIT 25
FROM traces-workshop.otel.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE host.geo.country_name IS NOT NULL | STATS count = COUNT(*) BY host.geo.country_name

FROM traces-workshop.otel.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE host.geo.country_name IS NOT NULL | STATS count = COUNT(*) BY host.geo.country_name | SORT count DESC | LIMIT 10
